name: M3_PPS200MI_UpdLine
description:
Update existing purchase order lines by changing commercial, logistical, planning, and user‑defined information. The line is uniquely identified by purchase order number, purchase order line, and purchase order line subnumber.  

  
Use this operation after a line has been created to revise, for example, purchase price and discounts, ordered quantity in alternate unit of measure, requested and planning dates, reference links to other orders or projects, goods receiving method, tax and trade‑statistics attributes, and user‑defined fields on the line. No data is returned; the purpose is to apply validated changes to the existing line record in M3.

inputParameters.description: Purchase order number of the line to update.

inputParameters.name: PNLI
inputParameters.description: Line number on the purchase order identifying the line to update.

inputParameters.name: PNLS
